title: Manga 'Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki' Ends in Next Chapter
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of Desert magazine announced on Thursday that Mika Yamamori 's Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ( In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ) manga will end with its next chapter. The 45th and final chapter is scheduled to be released in the December 2026 issue of Desert magazine on October 23.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Apothecary Diaries Movie Reveals New Trailer, Key Visual, and Kenshi Yonezu Theme Song
content: The Apothecary Diaries the Movie: The Late Lady’s Treasure has revealed its latest trailer and a new key visual ahead of its December 11, 2026 theatrical release in Japan. The new preview also confirms that the film’s theme song will be Kenshi Yonezu’s “Haru ga Tomori” (“Spring Lights”).
author: Anime Corner

title: Muv-Luv Alternative's Schwarzesmarken Games Get Steam Release
content: Hiroki Uchida 's original novels focus on the 666th TSF Squadron in 1983, 18 years before the events of the earlier serialized novel Muv-Luv Alternative: Total Eclipse . Both novels are spinoffs of Age's 2006 visual novel software Muv-Luv Alternative .
author: ANN

title: Gyakusatsu Kigen Manga Gets Animated Promotional Video
content: The official YouTube channel for Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine began streaming an animated promotional video on Wednesday to celebrate the debut of the first compiled book volume for Shiwasu Hoshikawa and Yūichirō Momose 's new manga Gyakusatsu Kigen (Genocide Origin). The volume shipped on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Bless TV Anime Casts Tarusuke Shingaki; Crunchyroll to Stream Series
content: The staff for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed in a character promotional video on Thursday that Tarusuke Shingaki will voice Hikaru Oya in the series.
author: ANN

title: 'Psyren' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the television anime adaptation of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga announced a pair of additional cast on Thursday. The anime series premiered on October 5 at 11.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11 and Sun TV.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Aobuta Film Opens at #4, New Live-Action Street Fighter Film at #8 in Japan
content: The live-action film reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise stayed at #2 in its second weekend. The film sold 189,000 tickets and earned 330,965,650 yen (about US$2.10 million) from Friday to Sunday.
